title: An Eco-Friendly Tourism Trip Planner Driven by Z-Number Uncertainty: Evidence from Baku, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Tashkent, and Istanbul
abstract: arXiv:2610.29120v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deployed tourism trip planners ingest travel times and ratings as exact numbers, although routing services return travel times that vary with the hour of departure and a platform rating may rest on a handful of reviews or on tens of thousands. We present an eco-friendly trip planner that represents both quantities as Z-numbers, which pair a fuzzy restriction on a value with a fuzzy reliability on the evidence behind it, and that constructs them directly from routing-service observations at six departure hours and from platform review counts rather than from linguistic elicitation. A hybrid loss combines score, carbon, travel-time, and reliability terms, and an adaptive large neighborhood search returns single-day itineraries with per-leg reliability annotations through a conversational front end. We compare the planner with a crisp-mean baseline under an identical optimizer in Baku, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Tashkent, and Istanbul, with fiftee

translated_title: 一种由Z数不确定性驱动的环保旅游行程规划器：来自巴库、迪拜、阿布扎比、塔什干和伊斯坦布尔的证据
translated_abstract: 已部署的旅游行程规划器通常将行程时间和评分作为精确数字处理，然而路径规划服务返回的行程时间会随出发时段而变化，且平台评分可能基于少数几条评论或数万条评论。我们提出了一种环保行程规划器，将这两种量表示为Z数——即将对某个值的模糊限制与其背后证据的模糊可靠性配对——并直接从六个出发时段的路径服务观测数据和平台评论数量构建Z数，而非通过语言启发式方法获取。该系统采用混合损失函数，综合了评分、碳排放、行程时间和可靠性等因素，并通过对话式前端，利用自适应大邻域搜索算法生成带有每段行程可靠性标注的单日行程。我们在巴库、迪拜、阿布扎比、塔什干和伊斯坦布尔五个城市，在相同优化器条件下将该规划器与清晰均值基线进行了比较，实验采用十五……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Z数的环保旅游行程规划器，直接从路径服务观测和平台评论数构建行程时间与评分的模糊不确定性表示，结合混合损失函数与自适应大邻域搜索，在五个城市中生成带可靠性标注的低碳单日行程。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an eco-friendly trip planner that represents travel times and ratings as Z-numbers constructed directly from routing-service observations and platform review counts, combining a hybrid loss function with adaptive large neighborhood search to generate low-carbon single-day itineraries with per-leg reliability annotations across five cities.
